Mining Picks for Hull.title: Mining Picks for Hull
Mining Picks for Hull.content: {{Quest | imagefilename = | width = | caption = | Start Zone = [[Underdocks]] | Quest Giver = [[Hull Orbel]] | Minimum Level = | Classes = ALL | Related NPCs = }} == Notes == This quest is repeatable. == Rewards == * Experience * 2 Silver, 18 Copper * Random piece of [[Patched Rawhide]] armor or [[Patched Cloth]] * Faction with [[Delvestone Mining Company]], [[The Underwatch]], [[Citizens of Underdocks]] == Walkthrough == '''This quest begins in the [[Underdocks]] upper city district by talking with [[Hull Orbel]]. Hull is located near the Delvestone miners on the northeast side of the upper city.''' You say, "Hail, Hull Orbel." : Hull Orbel says, "Bandits! Blaggards! Mold-eating malefactors!" You say, "What bandits?" : Hull Orbel says, "Aye! The Deepcut are murderers and thieves. Indeed!" You say, "Who are the deepcut?" : Hull Orbel says, "Reptiles! Ruffians! Every last one of 'em. Darrowdwell is ours to mine by right." : Hull Orbel shakes his head. : Hull Orbel says, "Say, whip the rascals and I'll pay you handsomely for four reclaimed mining picks!" You say, "Where is Darrowdwell?" : Hull Orbel says, "Aye, the mine is just beneath yer feet. Full of precious gems and ores, if it weren't for those profiteers. Parasites!" '''[[Hull Orbel]] is looking for [[Delvestone Mining Pick]] from the Deepcut miners, which can be found in the mines on the rafters level. Take the elevator directly across from Hull Orbel on the southeast side of the wooden bridge.''' '''Note that [[Broken Mining Pick]] will NOT work for this quest.''' '''Upon handing in 4 [[Delvestone Mining Pick]] to Hull Orbel...''' {{exp}} : Hull Orbel laughs heartily. : Hull Orbel says, "Ye've done it! Curse the assassins! Earthworms! Take this as a token of our appreciation." Your faction standing with [[Delvestone Mining Company]] got better. Your faction standing with [[The Underwatch]] got better. Your faction standing with [[Citizens of Underdocks]] got better. Your faction standing with [[Deepcut Bandits]] got worse. You receive [[Patched Rawhide]] or [[Patched Cloth]] from Hull Orbel. You receive 3 silver, 18 copper from Hull Orbel.
